Rick uses his frustration at the loss to overcome Tala and goes on to face Kai in a tiebreaker. Despite his great power, Rick loses to the more experienced Kai. Inspired by the match, Tyson vows to face Barthez Battalion with everything he's got.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The BBA Revolution are slated to face the sneaky Barthez Battalion, but while Hilary and Kenny want to report their dirty deeds to the authorities, Tyson believes the best way to teach them a lesson is to beat them fair and square'But that's before he really sees how low the team will sink to win. When Mathilda blows up her beyblade on purpose, just to cause damage to Daichi's Strata Dragoon, Tyson and his team are shocked'But Tyson stands his ground! Although Daichi wants to give Jean Paul Barthez himself a piece of his mind'Tyson holds him back, knowing that all will be decided in the beyblade dish'or will it? Tyson prepares to face off against Miguel, but how will he fare against the team leader's own dirty tricks'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes land in Egypt for the next leg of the tournament where the first two teams going up against each other are the Blitzkrieg Boys against the Barthez Battalion. But as Barthez readies his team, we learn he's devised a special spider web-like tape that is supposed to shoot out of his team's blades and trap their opponents in an inescapable web. Miguel is torn and knows that if they follow his coach's plan they could win, but he feels he'd rather lose with respect than cheat. In the first battle, Aaron goes up against Tala. Barthez tells his players to just act natural and he would operate the spider webbing by remote control. As the battle begins, Barthez desperately pushes the remote control, but nothing happens. Turns out Aaron refused to use the 'fixed' blade. Barthez is furious. Miguel is defiant and tell Barthez that they aren't going to be 'his puppets anymore.' As Barthez leaves, Miguel steps into the ring against Kai. The battle doesn't last very long as Kai wins handily. But Miguel has lost with dignity and that's just the way he wants it!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is having trouble convincing Rick that he is truly dedicated to the PPB All Starz. Max just wants to play for love of the game but Rick thinks he should do anything to win. When the competition continues Max demands they fight a 'pairs' match so that he and Rick are forced to work as a team. Rick's ego gets the best of him and soon he finds himself not only battling the White Tiger X team but Max as well. Mariah tells Ray and Lee of White Tiger X that they should battle each other and find out who is the best blader out of the four of them. A beyblading free for all ensues until the final climactic battle when only one blade is left spinning. The winner is surprised as everyone else to learn that he is the best blader of them all!'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Egyptian leg of the World Championships culminates with the final match highlighting F Dynasty against the BBA Revolution. The day before the match, Tyson has Daichi practice moves with him that they're not usually accustomed to doing: namely, tag-team attacks. F Dynasty is renowned for their tag-team abilities, and Tyson wants nothing more than to beat them at their own game. He knows this will be a challenge, as F Dynasty has already used the tag-team format to defeat White Tiger X earlier in the tournament. But as the former Beyblade world champion, Tyson feels it's his duty to prove that he's the best, no matter what the format is. F Dynasty meanwhile, foregoes practicing in favor of another fantastic street show of their beyblading skills for a crowd of onlookers. In a flashback to their childhood, we learn that Raul and Julia have been performing as a duo since their formative years growing up in the circus. The introduction of beyblades to their act only solidified their skills. When the day of the match arrives, Tyson specifically requests the two-on-two format and F Dynasty agrees. The sand-filled Sahara dish gives Tyson and Daichi the pre-battle advantage, but during the match, Tyson's beyblade has trouble keeping up. Coach Hiro realizes that the pressure Tyson is feeling to carry his team as the former Beyblade champion is affecting his performance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is feeling the pressure of being World Champion. Despite Hiro's warning, a television crew follows him around for a day, taping his every move. Daichi feels jealous and tries to compete for the camera's attention. Finally, BBA Revolution holds a three-way match between Tyson, Daichi and Kenny for the cameras and Tyson loses like an amateur. Tyson contemplates quitting and wanders to the Beystadium to be alone with his thoughts. Daichi confronts him and challenges him to a match. During the beybattle, Tyson is reminded of how it feels to beyblade for the pure love of the game. The pressure disappears when Tyson realizes he doesn't have to beyblade like a champion. He just has to beyblade like himself! Tyson meets Kai, Max and Ray ands tells them that, from now on, they are all challengers and any one of them could end up as champion.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final elimination round is underway, with F Dynasty trying to earn the last play-off slot, while their opponents, the already mathematically eliminated Barthez Battalion try to spoil their chances. Feeling like the weak link of the team, Raul surprises Julia by insisting he battle solo for F Dynasty, in order to prove his worth. Julia reluctantly agrees. In the first match Julia easily defeats Miguel, piling even more pressure on Raul. Raul is up against Mathilda of Barthez Battalion (who is using a combination of parts from her team's Beyblades) in the second match. Raul freezes under the pressure, and it looks like he is a sitting duck. But Julia steps in to explain to Raul that the only reason she has so much confidence in battle is because she has him at her side. This fires Raul up, and he battles back to steal the victory. The Barthez Battalion team are eliminated, but they are very gracious in defeat.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With Lee losing to Tala early in the match, White Tiger X is a game down, and Kai now steps up to battle for the Blitzkrieg Boys. This round is sure to be intense, as old teammates face off in the dish. Ray will represent White Tiger X, and the world is watching. The pressure seems too much for the players, as Ray collapses from the strain. Somehow he finds the strength to keep going, and the desire to bring Kai down! The intensity rises as the battle continues, with both players on either side of the dish so evenly matched, who can predict which one will walk away with the victory?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The fight is a tough one. In fact, the combatants are going at it so hard that the entire arena is filled with the acrid smell of burnt metal. This seems to be a battle of wills rather than blades as each Blader attempts to summon every ounce of power that they can. In the end, Daichi proves to be the winner, and Rick is devastated. Daichi on the other hand has used so much energy that he passes out. Now it's time for the next round, and it pits Tyson against his former teammate, Max!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Max face off against each other in the semi-final of the World Beyblading Championships. The two old friends use two totally different blading styles in the dish. Tyson takes the offense while Max hangs back and chooses for a more defensive style. Tyson has a tough time battling Max and when Dragoon starts to lose power he starts his engine gear. When he goes in for the final hit, Max suddenly goes on the offense and starts Draciel's engine gear. Just when it looks like Dragoon is going to be knocked out Tyson cleverly uses Draciel's own power against it and defeats Max! This allows Tyson's team, the BBA Revolution, to move on to the final round of the competition!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three teams qualifying for the finals of the World Beyblade Championships ' the Blitzkrieg Boys, the BBA Revolution, and F Dynasty - the BBA must make a decision. Only two teams can play in the finals, and a format to determine which ones will compete must be decided. Will they stage a mini-round robin tournament between the three teams? Or will the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty, who are both tied for second place battle, with the winner moving on to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in the finals? These questions will all take time to answer - time the various competitors use to catch up with family members. With the PPB All Starz eliminated from the tournament, Max visits his folks and then drops by the local community center where he and Ray first told Tyson they were leaving the Bladebreakers. Tyson goes home to visit Grandpa, and Daichi tags along, making himself a little too at home in the process. Grandpa is impressed by Tyson's newfound seriousness when it comes to his martial arts training. Coach Romero of F Dynasty gives Raul and Julia a surprise when he brings them to visit the circus, which just happens to be in town. The circus is where the siblings grew up, and a heartfelt reunion ensues. At BBA Headquarters, Mr. Dickenson announces the finals format. The two second place teams will indeed face each other first, with the victor getting to advance. Tyson surprises everyone by requesting that his match be a tag-team battle. Kenny gives Tyson his newly created Dragoon Galaxy Turbo, an improved version of Dragoon, which performs well in tag-team practice. Tyson and Daichi are pumped - they couldn't be more ready for their upcoming rematch against F Dynasty.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The entire city is pumped for Tyson and Daichi's rematch with F Dynasty in double-team play. At first, the awesome power of BBA Revolution has Raul and Julia on their heels. Raul manages to save Julia from a stadium out and his big sister lets him take command. Encouraged by the support of their circus family, the brother and sister use their experience and teamwork to push the BBA Revolution to the brink of defeat. Tyson and Daichi are losing strength when they realize they are having the time of their lives. There's nothing like competing against powerful, skilled opponents. The BBA Revolution has one last shot at victory. Can Daichi and Tyson manage to use a risky move from F Dynasty's playbook to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat? When Tyson's gambit wins the match, Raul and Julia are stunned to hear the crowd cheering for the BBA Revolution and F Dynasty! They are overwhelmed with pride as Kai leaves the stadium. At last, he will face Tyson for the World Championship.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals have finally arrived and BBA Revolution gets ready to face the Blitzkrieg Boys in a heated battle. But before that can happen, a routine check-up of Tyson's Beyblade turns up a faulty gear assembly, which needs to be repaired! Time is running out, and Daichi has to stretch out his match with Tala to give Kenny the time he needs to fix Dragoon! Just when things look their bleakest, Kenny brings Dragoon back to its former glory, which gets Daichi off the hook! And now, instead of running away from Tala, he comes back with an intense attack! But is it too late to get back the advantage over his crafty opponent?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Daichi and Tala have both been thrown from the dish at the same time, resulting in a tie game. Because they are in no condition for a rematch, Mr. Dickenson rules that the next match will determine the new tournament Champion. It all comes down to Kai and Tyson. Kai shows up for the match battered and bruised from his training session with Spencer and Bryan, just so he can put himself at Tyson's level of physical exhaustion, since Tyson had already battled earlier in the day. Kai wants them to be evenly matched so that he won't have any advantage in battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now a dilemma arises. Mr. Dickenson has to make the final decision and he's leaning toward calling it a tie because he's afraid that if they continue the battle, someone could get hurt. But Kai steps up to the plate and pleads his case for the battle to continue, which it does! As the fight resumes, the intensity is felt throughout the arena. Again they are evenly matched and it looks like no one will take it, when' they both mount a final assault! It's huge! In the end, Tyson comes out on top and Daichi and Tyson become the new Beyblade Tag Team World Champions!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi win the Beyblade Tag Team World Championship but Daichi is jealous that Tyson is getting all the attention. He decides the only way he can get the respect he deserves is to go on a training mission and come back and defeat Tyson on his own. He hitches a ride on a truck and falls asleep but wakes up far away from home, alone and hungry. Luckily he runs into Max and his father who invite him back to their house for dinner. During the meal Max squirts mustard on Daichi's steak telling him it will make it taste better. This disgusts Daichi, and in his anger he insults Max and his father. Max takes offense and challenges Daichi to a Beyblade battle. The match is a close one and Daichi is confident he can beat Max but he was beaten by Max's strength. He decides that the only way he can become a better Blader is to start training with Max. Meanwhile Tyson discovers Daichi gone and wonders why and where his Blading partner has gone.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A news bulletin announces that the BBA has been bought and transformed into a new, professional league, named the BEGA League and that Mr. Dickenson has resigned from his position as Chairman. The kids go off in search of their old friend and demand an explanation. Ashamed, Mr. Dickenson reveals that the board of the BBA had completed the plans to sell the league while he was occupied with the World Championships. Tyson resolves to show up at the press conference the next day and discover who is behind the plot. But at the press conference, he is faced with the new singing sensation, Ming-Ming who announces that not only is she the official mascot of the BEGA League but also its top ranked professional Beyblader. Tyson challenges her to Beybattle and Ming-Ming accepts under the condition that Tyson beat her entire Ming-Ming Band. Will Tyson, Max and Daichi be able to beat the Beybattling band and face off against an old foe?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max, Kenny and Daichi are invited by Boris to take a tour inside his new BEGA headquarters. Hilary isn't allowed inside until the official public opening, and is sent away, much to her chagrin. The boys find that the BEGA building is unparalleled in the quality of its Beyblade training and facilities. Impressive as it is however, Tyson is still highly distrustful of Boris, who was responsible for trying to take over the world two years ago by using his team the Demolition Boys as soldiers. Boris tries to convince Tyson that he's changed. Ever since his scheme was uncovered, he roamed throughout his homeland doing some soul searching. There, while watching some village children Beyblade, he had an epiphany. He realized that Beyblading is all about honor and individuality, and he made it his new goal to bring Beyblading to the masses. That's why he took over the BBA and turned it into BEGA ' as a way to give children around the world that had no exposure to the game a chance to better their lives and become champions themselves. Tyson is still skeptical, and his bad-mouthing of Boris draws the ire of a top BEGA prospect ' a juggernaut named Crusher, whose Beyblade launcher is the biggest one the boys have ever seen. When grilled by Tyson about his motives for joining this professional league, Crusher admits he's doing it for the prospect of getting rich, but only so he can afford to pay his younger sister's hospital bills. A Beybattle ensues, and Crusher shows he's even more powerful than he looks. Tyson is nearly defeated, but he summons his will and narrowly defeats his jumbo-sized opponent. When Boris asks Tyson if he now believes he's sincere in his reasons for creating BEGA, Tyson still isn't sure. But Tyson does admit that if spirited and honorable Blader's like Crusher are in it, maybe there is some merit in the new league after all.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A mysterious stranger wanders the woods of White Tiger Hills, the headquarters of the White Tiger X team, and although this strange young man performs incredible good deeds, Lee and the rest of the team are suspicious, and tell their leader Ray, all about him. It isn't long until the entire team meets up with him again, and Ray comes face to face with the stranger's incredible abilities like leaping, flying and jumping through the air, not to mention Beyblading like a world champion. He calls himself Mystel and amazes Lee and Ray with the mixture of his incredible acrobatics and Beyblading skills. Lee imagines how good the White Tiger X team would be if they knew how to move like Mystel, and, after challenging their new guest to a battle, has high hopes that he'll share his secrets. But Lee is humiliated by a quick loss, and now it's up to Ray to represent the team in it's own backyard! Can he beat Mystel, and more importantly, can he find out the secrets behind this mysterious young Beyblader?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson can't seem to make up his mind whether or not to trust Boris and go pro. When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.desc: In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, Thorogood and his band have released 16 albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Lady Gaga -- Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on Sept. 1, 2013 marks her first full concert since the Born This Way Ball.

programme.title: Scorpions - Forever And A Day: Live In Munich
programme.desc: After 50 years on stages all around the world, Germany's Scorpions decided it was time to embark on one last tour. This fully authorized documentary follows the hard rockers from their beginnings as young music fans to the present day.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the Circus Krone in Munich, this concert features performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next to the Moon" and more.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this production of Guns N' Roses performing live at the O2 Arena featuring hits: Paradise City, Sweet Child O' Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Letlive: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Experience Letlive performing at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Celebrate the music and the city that shaped it.

programme.title: Carole King: Welcome to My Living Room
programme.desc: Carole King performs an intimate 2005 concert in Southern California, featuring 21 Top 40 hits from her legendary career.

programme.title: Berner / AJ Rafael: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Berner explores his cannabis empire and filmmaking, while AJ Rafael shares how launching his clothing brand reignited his music career.

programme.title: Motörhead - Live: Everything Louder Than Everything Else
programme.desc: Motörhead performs a high-volume live set in Munich, delivering classics like Ace of Spades and Killed By Death.

programme.title: Maestro
programme.desc: Maestro follows Grammy award-winning conductor Paavo Järvi and brilliant musicians performing in sold-out halls worldwide.

programme.title: Gottmik / Mayer Hawthorne: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Gottmik launches a beauty brand, while Mayer Hawthorne shares his wine and vinyl-inspired business journey.

programme.title: Black Label Society & Zakk Sabbath
programme.desc: Black Label Society and Zakk Sabbath deliver high-energy performances. Experience the debut of 'Ozzy's Song' and an interview with Zakk Wylde.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Daryl Palumbo of Glassjaw and Head Automatica. Daryl reflects on three decades of genre-defying music, the freedom he’s always pursued as an artist, the self-doubt and restlessness that shaped his work, and how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling experience of his life.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy-nominated drummer Aric Improta joins Joel Madden to talk about the sacredness of creativity, the balance between chaos and discipline, and the art of manifestation. They reflect on Improta’s upbringing in a family of artists, his work with Fever 333 and Night Verses, and the philosophy behind sustaining inspiration while navigating the demands of modern music.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Actor and writer O’Shea Jackson Jr. joins Joel Madden for an insightful conversation about Hollywood’s misconceptions, family legacy, and creative purpose. Jackson discusses balancing fame with authenticity, lessons from his upbringing, the importance of privacy in the digital age, and how writing became a core outlet for his creativity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Drag superstar, musician, and TV personality Trixie Mattel joins Joel Madden for a candid conversation about growing up in small-town Wisconsin, discovering drag, and building a multifaceted career in music, television, and business. They discuss identity, faith, creativity, and the crossover between drag and punk culture — finding connection through authenticity and humor.

programme.title: Korn: Live
programme.desc: Korn performs a hit-filled live set at Hammerstein Ballroom, featuring songs like Freak on a Leash and Here to Stay.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Dan + Shay. Dan + Shay met at a house party in Nashville in December 2012 and started writing songs together not long after — an unlikely pairing, given Dan came from an emo band background and Shay had been a solo artist on T-Pain's label. Since then, the duo has become one of the most decorated acts in country music history: three consecutive Grammy Awards for Best Country Duo/Group Performance for "Tequila," "Speechless," and "10,000 Hours" with Justin Bieber, alongside dozens of ACM, CMA, and Billboard Music Award wins. Their crossover success has made them global streaming juggernauts, and in 2024 they became the first-ever coaching duo in the history of NBC's The Voice. Sitting down with Joel, Dan + Shay open up about the highs of over a decade together — the awards, the arenas, the recognition — but also the harder work underneath it: learning to communicate honestly, untangling their self-worth from their results, and figuring out what it actually means to build a lasting partnership, both as a band and as best friends.

programme.title: Porno for Pyros: Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour Live from Los Angeles
programme.desc: Porno for Pyros take the stage one final time for their Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour, performing live from The Belasco Theater in Los Angeles. Frontman Perry Farrell, guitarist Peter DiStefano, drummer Stephen Perkins, and bassist Martyn LeNoble deliver an electrifying and emotional performance that spans their entire career — from hits like Pets and Tahitian Moon to deep cuts and spoken interludes that showcase their surreal, art-rock energy. Captured exclusively on Veeps, this farewell show celebrates three decades of psychedelic alternative rock and the enduring chemistry that defined the band’s sound.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now - All Access Watch Party
programme.desc: GHOST’s debut film RITE HERE RITE NOW blends live performance with a narrative story. Filmed at Los Angeles' Kia Forum during the RE-IMPERATOUR tour finale.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Laufey’s: A Night at the Symphony - Hollywood Bowl
programme.desc: A cinematic concert film capturing Laufey’s spellbinding homecoming at the Hollywood Bowl, performed with the Los Angeles Philharmonic. Blending jazz-pop songwriting with lush orchestration, Laufey guides viewers through an evening of romance, nostalgia, and self-discovery—interwoven with behind-the-scenes moments, reflections on Los Angeles, and a special appearance from her twin sister, Junia.

programme.title: Don't Go Gentle: A Film About IDLES
programme.desc: Don’t Go Gentle chronicles the rise of British punk band IDLES, exploring how a group of friends from Bristol transformed pain and vulnerability into creative power. Through candid interviews, raw live performances, and emotional moments, the film captures the band’s journey from small clubs to international acclaim.

programme.title: Rascal Flatts: Life Is a Highway Tour: Live from Columbus
programme.desc: Country superstars Rascal Flatts celebrate 25 years of music with a hometown performance in Columbus, Ohio, recorded on their Life Is a Highway Tour. The set features timeless hits like Bless the Broken Road, What Hurts the Most, Mayberry, Fast Cars and Freedom, and Life Is a Highway. It’s an evening filled with nostalgia, gratitude, and classic country harmony.

programme.title: Chase Atlantic: Live from Hollywood
programme.desc: Chase Atlantic, an Australian trio based in LA, produce unique pop rock/R&B fusion. Their sound is identifiable through Mitchel Cave’s vocals and danceable tracks.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter Joss Stone joins Joel Madden for a candid conversation about growing up in the music industry, her love of horror movies, and the process of creating a live album.

programme.title: Waterparks: FANDOM Live in the UK
programme.desc: A kinetic concert film captured at a sold-out O2 Academy Birmingham (Jan 2020), where Waterparks perform FANDOM through an alternate-universe lens. Executive producers Awsten Knight and Jawn Rocha fuse practical and special effects so every song looks the way it feels on stage—euphoric, chaotic, and intimate. Setlist highlights include crowd-igniting moments like “Dream Boy,” “High Definition,” “Dizzy,” and more, with circle pits, call-and-response, and fourth-wall breaks as the band records a live CD/DVD with the audience.

programme.title: The Specials: A Message To You
programme.desc: This episode of Record On explores how The Specials emerged from late-1970s Britain amid political unrest, racial tension, and economic struggle. Through rare footage and new interviews with Lynval Golding, Horace Panter, Pauline Black, Rhoda Dakar, and Damon Albarn, the film examines how the band’s fusion of ska and punk became an anthem for unity.

programme.title: Oasis: Live by the Sea
programme.desc: Oasis performs a 1995 concert in Southend, delivering early hits like Live Forever and Supersonic as they rise to international fame.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Simple Plan frontman Pierre Bouvier joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on balancing family and touring life, creative longevity, and the band’s continued success. They revisit their early 2000s pop-punk roots, reflect on 20+ years of friendship, and discuss Simple Plan’s special edition book with Alternative Press as the band enters one of its strongest eras yet.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Chase Rice talks about his hit song, the challenges of festivals, and his experience at Stagecoach.

programme.title: Dropkick Murphys: St. Patrick’s Day 2024 Live from Boston
programme.desc: Dropkick Murphys return home to Boston for their annual St. Patrick’s Day concert at the MGM Music Hall at Fenway, performing fan favorites like “The Boys Are Back,” “The State of Massachusetts,” “Queen of Suffolk County,” and “Johnny, I Hardly Knew Ya.” With surprise guest Billy Bragg opening the show, plus appearances by Kneecap and Pennywise, the night captures the fierce pride, Celtic punk energy, and hometown spirit that define the band’s legacy.

programme.title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
programme.desc: Jay Pharoah delivers a stand-up special packed with celebrity impressions and sharp humor, featuring takes on icons like Jay-Z, Barack Obama, and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Hongjoong of ATEEZ on life as a K-pop artist and Korea's global cultural influence.

programme.title: Cypress Hill: Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Cypress Hill performs with the London Symphony Orchestra at the Royal Albert Hall. Hits from Black Sunday and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Mikaela Hoover discusses art and life on Artist Friendly, sharing personal insights and her pride in her wife's company, House of Harlow.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Elliot Grainge joins Joel Madden for a personal talk on family, fatherhood, and the music business. The 10K Projects founder and Atlantic Records CEO reflects on love, loss, resilience, and legacy.

programme.title: Kansas: Miracles out of Nowhere
programme.desc: A 2015 full-length documentary film tells the untold story of a successful American rock band. In-depth interviews with all 6 original members recount their rise.

programme.desc: Oasis performs an intimate rehearsal set at Black Island Studios, featuring tracks from Dig Out Your Soul alongside classics and rarities.

programme.title: Spiritwalker [English Dub]
programme.desc: With amnesia, a man shifts bodies every 12 hours, racing against time to regain memories and evade unknown threats.

programme.title: Crypto Man [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Crushed by his mother's expectations, Do-hyun exploits Korea's system of privilege, from forged documents to government subsidies, culminating in his cryptocurrency ''MOMMY coin'' as scrutiny threatens his success.

programme.title: Beasts Clawing at Straws [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A large bag of money appears in front of Tae-young, Jung-man, and Yeon-hee. Unexpected events occur to them chasing the bag of money, believing it to be the last chance.

programme.title: OK! MADAM [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Miyoung, the owner of a twisted donut shop, goes on a first-time trip to Hawaii with her husband Seokhwan. However, their plane is hijacked all of a sudden.

programme.title: DETECTIVE K: SECRET OF THE LIVING DEAD [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When a series of unusual murders occurs, Detective K (KIM Myung-min) and his partner (OH Dal-soo) are once again called into action as they discover a trail of bodies with mysterious bite marks.

programme.title: THE ASSASSINS [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the year 198, Cao Cao, Prime Minister of the Han Dynasty, ventured to the east and defeated China's greatest warrior Lu Bu, terrifying every ambitious warlord across the country. Several years later, after taking the Han Emperor under his wing, Cao crowns himself King of Wei. He built a magnificent Bronze Sparrow Island to symbolize his power and rumors spread that he would replace the Emperor. Meanwhile, young lovers Mu Shun and Ling Ju are taken from a prison camp to a hidden tomb, where they spend five cruel years together, training as assassins for a secret mission. In the year 220 astronomical signs predict dramatic change. As a result, Cao's son Cao Pi and Cao's followers urge Cao to become the new Emperor - but unknown opposing forces plot against him.

programme.title: POLICE STORY: LOCKDOWN [English Dub]
programme.desc: A man looking for the release of a long-time prisoner takes a police officer, his daughter, and a group of strangers hostage.

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: BADGES OF FURY [English Dub]
programme.desc: In just 3 days, three cases of Smiling Murder shock Hong Kong. The young detective Wang Bu'er and his buddy Huang Feihong embark on an investigation full of excitement and unexpected events.

programme.title: The Witch: Subversion [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ja-yoon enters a TV contest to help her family, but mysterious figures disrupt her life, revealing secrets from her forgotten past.

programme.title: Sea Fog [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Written and produced by Bong Joon-ho (PARASITE, SNOWPIERCER, THE HOST), SEA FOG is a maritime thriller that captures the essence of why he is considered on of the most talented filmmakers working today. Upon learning that his decaying fishing trawler, the Junjin, is about to be sold, Captain Kang looks to make one final score by smuggling illegal immigrants from China to South Korea. After arriving at the agreed pickup point, a violent storm forces the Junjin to stall in open waters. As tension and unrest spread, Kang and his five-man crew find themselves pitted against their desperate passengers – all while an ominous fog envelops the ship and everyone onboard.

programme.title: The Tooth and the Nail [English Sub]
programme.desc: In Seoul, a soon after acquiring independence from Japanese occupation, two men met and there came the sound of six shots firing. The police arrests Nam Do-jin, the wealthiest man as a suspect for the murder of a driver named Choi Seung-man. However, all they could find was a burnt body, blood spots, and chopped off fingers. As the trial goes on, it becomes more obvious that the murder had been meticulously planned out and carried out.

programme.title: Spiritwalker [English Dub]
programme.desc: With amnesia, a man shifts bodies every 12 hours, racing against time to regain memories and evade unknown threats.

programme.title: Marui Video [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The video evidence of the murder, which is especially brutal and graphic, that shouldn't be released to the public; a reporter who has access to the prosecutor's office hears about a cursed tape in the video archive and begins reporting on it.

programme.title: The Unrighteous [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A realistic horror film about a young man trying to protect his family from his neighbors after illegal flyers are distributed in an old villa in the suburbs, leading to a sense of unease.

programme.title: The Sin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Si-young has been chosen to play the lead role in an experimental art film centered around her dance major. Along with her college friend Chae-yoon, they perform geometric dance routines as part of a shamanic ceremony as directed by the film's director. However their world is turned upside down when a production team member suddenly falls from the roof but their seemingly lifeless body begins to move and come to life.

programme.title: Sinkhole [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: After finally realizing his dream of owning a house in Seoul, Dong-won held housewarming parties and invited some of his co-workers. But his happiness is short-lived as the entire building falls to the ground. Dongwon, his co-workers Kim and Eun-joo, and a nosy neighbor, Man-soo, must make it out of a 500-meter sinkhall.

programme.title: The Witch: Subversion [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ja-yoon enters a TV contest to help her family, but mysterious figures disrupt her life, revealing secrets from her forgotten past.

programme.title: Sea Fog [English Subtitle]

Upon learning that his decaying fishing trawler, the Junjin, is about to be sold, Captain Kang looks to make one final score by smuggling illegal immigrants from China to South Korea. After arriving at the agreed pickup point, a violent storm forces the Junjin to stall in open waters. As tension and unrest spread, Kang and his five-man crew find themselves pitted against their desperate passengers – all while an ominous fog envelops the ship and everyone onboard.

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Nutri Ventures
programme.desc: Protecting Healthy Foods At All Costs!

programme.title: Chefclub Kids
programme.desc: With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

programme.title: Hogie the Globehopper
programme.desc: Hogie the Globehopper is a fun tv show that will inspire a curiosity and fascination about the world and its people. Hogie and his friends Lorna, Bernie and Floaty travel the world, making lots of friends along the way.

programme.title: Mya Go
programme.desc: Mya Go is a preschool animated show about a young girl whose enthusiasm infects everyone around her. Set in the bustling town of Everyday, Mya Go lives here with the Go family and lives nearby her closest friends.

programme.title: Bernard
programme.desc: Follow Bernard as he makes a mess of things!

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: Domi Kids is a brand-new 3D animated musical series created by Leqing Media. With lively and engaging music, multiple characters bring to life the warm and joyful daily adventures of Domi and his family of five. The show features diverse themes, captivating stories, and vibrant scenes. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a delightful audiovisual experience for children. With positive and entertaining content, the series helps young kids learn about the world at an age-appropriate pace while supporting parents in making parenting easier and more enjoyable.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

programme.title: BarryTiger

It follows BarryTiger and his lovable friends as they play, learn, and discover new things every day. programme.desc: A mysterious computer virus wipes out highly classified personnel files at the NSA, prompting a top secret investigation. Raymond Berry, an NSA operative suspected of crimes against the United States, risks his life to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Susie's Hope
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the inspirational relationship between Donna Lawrence (Emmanuelle Vaguer) a pit bull attack survivor, and Susie (Susie Lawrence), an abused pit bull-mix puppy, as they learn to heal and forgive together.

programme.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
programme.desc: Surrounded by wealth and living with abundant resources in Manhattan, 12-year-old cello prodigy Reggie, lives a solitary life lacking only frequently absent parents and friends. Estranged from family, having slacker boyfriend troubles, and fired from her waitressing job, sometimes musician 23-year-old Eleanor needs a new place to live and a new job.

programme.title: Watercolor Postcards
programme.desc: A small town girl with a troubled past returns home only to find that both her sister and her hometown are in peril. Only when she falls for a man who similarly has dark days behind him will they muster up the faith and love needed to save the things they hold dear in life.

programme.desc: A young man named Walt Disney had big dreams, and no matter how many obstacles he had to face he never gave up--from his tumultuous childhood, to serving his country, to borrowing money, to the creation of his first iconic animated character Mickey Mouse.

programme.title: Camp Cool Kids

programme.title: Symphonic Metal Epicness
programme.desc: Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Metalcore Madness
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate pit. Metalcore Madness brings you the visual pulse of metalcore and deathcore—packed with blistering solos, heavy breakdowns, and raw energy. Turn it up, open the pit, and let the madness take over!

programme.title: Progressive Metal Laboratory
programme.desc: A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián le cuenta a Armando un poco de cosas echándoselas de machista. Pero le dice que ya está de nuevo viviendo con Finita. Finita le sigue contando a su amiga Rossy que mientras no se enteren ni Fabián ni Armando | ella es feliz. Mauricio está de nuevo contándole a Pastor que él tiene que fingir ante la gente pero en ese momento llega Atanasio. Pastor respira profundo. Ana le recrimina a Olegario que no la haya felicitado por su aumento.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le recrimina a Nayarí la forma de llegar al estudio. Ella le hace comprender que lo mismo le pasó con él en el barrio. Y finalmente llegan a un acuerdo, y Gabriel acepta decirle a Deibis que es su tío, en lugar de su padre. Todos están muy intrigados por la llegada de Nayarí, pero sobre todo Angie. Epi le cuenta a Gloria que Valentina cree que él es gay. Efraín se encuentra a almorzar con Valentina. Y ella se va muy acongojada al escuchar las palabras de Efraín diciendo, que es una extraña en la vida de Julieta. Ricardo va a la casa de Julieta a buscar un supuesto CD. Julieta le presenta a su mamá, Ana Belén. Ricardo le confiesa que fue por ella, y que quiere que se encuentren a solas en algún lugar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia y Manuela interrumpen el compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que termina en agresiones. Benjamín es herido en la cárcel por orden de Katiuska. Celia decide ocultar su enfermedad terminal a Ricardo, mientras que Elizabeth, al enterarse del nuevo compromiso de su padre, lo rechaza definitivamente. Alejandro revela que Néstor quedará libre, y Misael, ebrio, acosa a Manuela. Finalmente, Celia echa a Ricardo de su casa tras quitarle las llaves.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Eustoquio se viste de Benedicto burlándose de Erasto frente a Humberto. Consuelo le confiesa a Leticia su desesperación por el rechazo de Rosa. Carmen Rosa miente a Rosa diciendo que culpó la fiebre por la confesión; Rosa le cree. Adolfo cuenta a su familia el hallazgo de su hija. Rosalía exige pruebas y jura odiar a Rosa. Marisela cae en cuenta que el hijo de Rosa es de Junior, su propio hermano, y debe ser abortado. Erasto recibe la escritura de la quinta para Natalia y le pide a Arminda llamarla, mientras Arminda informa a Eustoquio para vengarse.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Jimena le cuenta a Leonardo que Keka vio a Rebeca y su doctor abrazándose y le pide que cancelara la ceremonia de renovación de votos. Leonardo no le cree pero se queda pensando al respecto de eso, por lo que, decide ir a preguntarle directamente a Rebeca lo ocurrido. Rebeca inmediatamente desmiente toda situación comprometedora con su doctor y se justifica diciendo que le rompe el corazón que piense que ella lo podría estar engañando. Adolfo amenaza a Rodrigo, debe encontrarla a Alejandra lo antes posible porque si no va a quedar gravemente inculpado en los actos de su novia. Adolfo no confía más en él.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que se encontraran Ana y Guillermo, cada uno con una vida muy distinta a la que hubieran imaginado, pero sintiendo lo mismo que sintieron aquella primera vez que se vieron, quedaron con muchas preguntas por hacerse. Eso lleva a Guillermo a contactar a Ana mediante un mensaje, que luego se transformó en una visita hacia la casa de ella. Ya uno, enfrente del otro comenzaron a preguntarse sobre sus respectivas parejas. Pero llegan a un punto donde deciden arriesgarse del todo. El primer impulso es dejarlo todo y comenzar de nuevo, pero empiezan a surgir los inconvenientes, uno de ellos, Guillermo tiene una hija a la cual deberá sacrificar el verla sólo los fines de semana.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto irrumpe en casa de Consuelo y exige llevarse a Natalia, pero ella se niega y él promete vengarse. Marisela exige a Adolfo evitar que Rosa tenga el niño. Alejandro le explica a Carmen Rosa lo del parentesco con Rosa y la convence de ayudar. Junior se compromete a casarse con Rosa pase lo que pase. Rosa decide casarse con Junior contra todos. Eustoquio sigue aterrorizando a Erasto disfrazado. Carmen Rosa duda en revelar el secreto. Consuelo decide ir a hablar con Rosa de nuevo, esta vez con calma. Isaías medita sobre la situación imposible.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rene examina a Carmen Rosa y la hospitalizan una semana. Leticia insiste en que Vilma intentó matarla. Consuelo le oculta a Natalia que Erasto la visitó. Marisela y Andreína preparan maletas para Estados Unidos. Chencha llega a la residencia atormentada por su secreto. Erasto compra una quinta a nombre de Natalia mediante Rivera. Eustoquio enfrenta a Erasto amenazándolo de muerte. René revela accidentalmente a Consuelo que Arminda, la tía de Rosa, es la mujer que tenía secuestrada a Natalia. Consuelo grita como loca y cae desmayada al unir los cabos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo se encierra en su cuarto recordando todos los maltratos que dio a Rosa sin saber que era su hija; confiesa a Leticia el descubrimiento. Junior defiende a Rosa de los insultos de Rosalía en la clínica. Alejandro confiesa a Adolfo que Rosa es su hija perdida, horrorizándolo al recordar que espera un hijo de Junior. Chencha confiesa a Blanca la verdad sobre Rosa. Erasto niega a Carmen Rosa toda culpa. Junior se desmaya al levantarse para ir al baño. Adolfo decide llamar a Consuelo para enfrentar la verdad con Rosa.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis y Natalia se reconcilian. Adolfo descubre por el médico que Junior sufrió parálisis motora y no podrá viajar. Rosa enfrenta a Consuelo en su casa y la expulsa, negándose a oírla y creéndola obsesionada con Isaías. Alejandro confiesa a Rosalía que Rosa es su hermana; ella jura odiarla siempre. Eustoquio se disfraza de Benedicto para enloquecer a Erasto. Adolfo y Marisela suspenden el viaje al exterior. Consuelo, abatida, llama a Adolfo desde el llanto para contarle que Rosa la odia a muerte y le concede toda la razón.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Eustoquio se viste de Benedicto burlándose de Erasto frente a Humberto. Consuelo le confiesa a Leticia su desesperación por el rechazo de Rosa. Carmen Rosa miente a Rosa diciendo que culpó la fiebre por la confesión; Rosa le cree. Adolfo cuenta a su familia el hallazgo de su hija. Rosalía exige pruebas y jura odiar a Rosa. Marisela cae en cuenta que el hijo de Rosa es de Junior, su propio hermano, y debe ser abortado. Erasto recibe la escritura de la quinta para Natalia y le pide a Arminda llamarla, mientras Arminda informa a Eustoquio para vengarse.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto irrumpe en casa de Consuelo y exige llevarse a Natalia, pero ella se niega y él promete vengarse. Marisela exige a Adolfo evitar que Rosa tenga el niño. programme.title: Episodio 101
programme.desc: Yubiri histérica y furiosa le como le comunica a los presentes que ha decidido renunciar | que se va de la Agencia. Briggite se muestra preocupada con la noticia mientras que cada uno se retrae en sus pensamientos. Yubiri le grita a Briggite una vez más su decisión de irse de la agencia. Entre tanto Wilker y su grupo de música ACAN de terminar la grabación de su disco; con un gran éxito; Los muchachos ríen y se disponen a celebrar | mientras Wilker internamente se regocija pensando en Yuribi.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Ana le dice a Pastor que no la bese ya que él es gay. Pastor le dice que no lo es | y que para conseguir el puesto con Mauricio tuvo que hacerse pasar por gay porque sino Mauricio no lo empleaba. En la casa de Gisela está Mauricio ya que son amigos de mucho tiempo. Ella trata de averiguar si es gay. El no cae en la trampa y llega Atanasio. Pastor ve la imagen de Olegario y el le dice a Ana que lo disculpe que no volverá a pasar aunque en verdad está enamorado de ella. A Ana le gustó Juan Diego.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker va a la casa de Yubiri para llevarle el CD. Cuando llega Yubiri está totalmente fuera de sí por lo de Briggite y le forma tremendo escándalo botándolo de la casa. El le deja el CD. Daniel Alvarado llega a la oficina de Junior. Graciela está que se muere y Daniel Alvarado le dice a Junior que el guión necesita unos ajustes. Esto no le gusta para nada a Junior. Wilker está sumamente triste caminando por el centro comercial y Solymar lo ve y lo va a saludar. El le regala un CD.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián le cuenta a Armando un poco de cosas echándoselas de machista. Pero le dice que ya está de nuevo viviendo con Finita. Finita le sigue contando a su amiga Rossy que mientras no se enteren ni Fabián ni Armando | ella es feliz. Mauricio está de nuevo contándole a Pastor que él tiene que fingir ante la gente pero en ese momento llega Atanasio. Pastor respira profundo. Ana le recrimina a Olegario que no la haya felicitado por su aumento.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es encarcelado y liberado tras meses por Hortensia, quien ignora que Julio César ordenó matarlo. Celia descubre que tiene una enfermedad terminal y lo oculta, aceptando que Ricardo dé su apellido al bebé. Katiuska quema una carta clave y busca dañar al hijo de Celia con brujería. Marcelo solicita el divorcio a Graciela y Misael prepara una prueba de ADN para Glorita, mientras se revela la verdadera naturaleza de Katiuska.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Misael le pide matrimonio a Manuela tras probar su paternidad, mientras Ovidio hace lo mismo con Celia, quien enferma gravemente. Katiuska realiza un ritual de magia negra contra Celia y se compromete con Ricardo. Alejandro se prepara para cumplir la promesa de matar a Néstor. Hortensia descubre que Celia es la madre del hijo de Benjamín y se opone a que lleve su apellido. Finalmente, Celia, Manuela y Elizabeth juran mantener en secreto la inminente muerte de Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, busca el perdón de su hermana. Mientras tanto, Gustavo inaugura su piano bar, evento al que asiste María del Pilar a escondidas. Manuela y Celia descubren con impacto la fiesta de compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que desata la furia de Celia. En medio de celebraciones con antifaces y romances nacientes entre Margot y Alejandro, la tragedia golpea cuando Carrero apuñala a Benjamín en su celda y Katiuska recurre a la brujería para retener a Ricardo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia y Manuela interrumpen el compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que termina en agresiones. Benjamín es herido en la cárcel por orden de Katiuska. Celia decide ocultar su enfermedad terminal a Ricardo, mientras que Elizabeth, al enterarse del nuevo compromiso de su padre, lo rechaza definitivamente. Alejandro revela que Néstor quedará libre, y Misael, ebrio, acosa a Manuela. Finalmente, Celia echa a Ricardo de su casa tras quitarle las llaves.
